what_it_does: Enables quantum chemistry simulations to scale from thousands to millions of atoms by speeding up real-time simulation of electron dynamics using density functional theory. Traditional approaches create computational bottlenecks when communicating results across many computers. This work uses a mathematical basis where each basis function is localized to a small region, reducing communication overhead. It also uses compression techniques on the numerical arrays involved in hybrid exchange-correlation calculations, bundling multiple related multiplications together to avoid recalculating the same intermediate results repeatedly.
